record.question: Absence of an informed consent while performing a procedure on a patient can lead to which of the following charges?
record.explanation: Answer B: Battery & malpractice. Performing a procedure without valid informed consent may constitute battery and professional malpractice, depending on circumstances and jurisdiction. Source/context note: Legal classification depends on jurisdiction, capacity, emergency exceptions, and the procedure. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK430827/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
